blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport at the scheduled time.

The São Paulo – Salvador flight is paid for separately.

On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel.

Salvador is known for its particularly strong Afro-Brazilian heritage.

Music, dance, cuisine and religious traditions are prominent in the city's culture.

Even outside festival periods, you can watch capoeira, try acarajé, a bean-and-shrimp dish fried in dendê oil, and discover candomblé traditions.

Coastal resort areas near Salvador offer beaches and all-inclusive hotels.

blocks.text: After breakfast, a private half-day city tour tracing the city’s development from its beginnings to the vibrant cultural capital it is today: towards the mouth of the immense bay, along elegant tree-lined avenues, to the Pelourinho, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the largest ensembles of colonial architecture in South America. From the Municipal Square, beside the towering Lacerda Elevator, with views across the bay to the Lower City, stroll through narrow, lively streets of colourful buildings to the Church of São Francisco, with its exuberant gilded Baroque interior, and the Pelourinho square, discovering capoeira, acarajé and the living traditions of Candomblé. After the tour, transfer to Praia do Forte and check in for your beach stay.
